title: Zero-Copy Uploads
content:
Handling file uploads in Photon is incredibly efficient because we leverage Bun's native FormData handling which maps files to disk or memory without V8 heap allocation.

Native Handling

app.post('/upload', async (c) => {
  const form = await c.req.formData()
  const file = form.get('profile_pic')
  
  if (file && file instanceof File) {
    // Direct disk write (Zero-Copy)
    await Bun.write('uploads/' + file.name, file)
    return c.json({ size: file.size })
  }
  
  return c.json({ error: 'No file' }, 400)
})

Performance Note: This method is approximately 3x faster than Multer on Node.js because the file binary data is never serialized into a JS buffer string.
